article.title: Iran Dirty Bomb Allegations
article.author: William J. Astore
article.content: The opinions expressed here are solely the author's and do not reflect the opinions or beliefs of the LA Progressive. I woke to the news that America’s mainstream media , always judicious and careful, sees a profound threat from Iran: A dirty bomb to be used against Washington, DC. Sources? Anonymous. Does Iran truly have a bomb or even the capability to deploy it against DC? Unlikely. Truth doesn’t matter here. It’s all about countering momentum building in Congress to put an end to the Iran war. Aaron Maté puts it well in this tweet: The Trump admin committed an unprecedented faux pas before launching its war on Iran: it didn't bother feeding corporate media a pro-war lie to promote. With one "dirty bomb" leak, harmony is being restored to the Beltway propaganda system: https://t.co/19E1KjLOWk — Aaron Maté (@aaronjmate) November 17, 2026 From 2002-03, we all remember the false allegation that Iraq had WMD and that Saddam Hussein was ready to use the same against America. As the saying went back then, “We can’t allow the smoking gun to become a mushroom cloud.” So the Bush/Cheney administration launched the disastrous Iraq war to destroy WMD that Iraq didn’t possess. Back to Iran. After declaring that he’d already destroyed alleged Iranian efforts to build a nuclear bomb, President Trump pivoted to say the Iran war is now about preventing Iran from building a nuke. That contradiction was so obvious, that rationale has proven to be so unpersuasive, that a new one had to be deployed, hence new allegations of a “dirty bomb,” which is in theory easier to make. Now, why Iran would attack DC with a dirty bomb, knowing that U.S. warmongers would likely respond by nuking Tehran, is anyone’s guess. I suppose Trump would respond that Iranians are terrorists and maniacs whose actions make no sense—to that, as we used to say, “it takes one to know one.” Related: Schumer and Jeffries: The Known Unknowns Sadly, the “Blunami” two weeks ago is unlikely to change Washington’s warmongering. While some Democrats may wish to block funding in Congress for the Iran war, they are unlikely to succeed, given Hakeem Jeffries, a tool of Israel, as Speaker. The old “Iraq has WMD!” ploy is being revived to cow Democrats into continuing to support the Iran war. After all, who wants to be blamed, even rhetorically, for allowing Iran to march a dirty bomb through Trump’s imaginary triumphant arch in DC? Addendum: It appears Democrats are preparing a $15 billion war aid package for Ukraine while criticizing Trump for being insufficiently hawkish on Russia and China. Something tells me the Pentagon budget is safe from major cuts. Or any cuts.
